description: This C# codebehind file for an ASP.NET Web Forms page manages exam question setup, including selecting courses based on semester, adding multiple-choice questions, setting exams, and navigation between pages within an online examination system.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.SetExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the web page for setting up exams with methods for navigation, question addition, course selection, and exam configuration.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently contains commented code.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the Home button, navigates to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the profile button click, navigates to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the leaderboard button click, navigates to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester, with specific course options.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears all input fields related to question and exam setup.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new multiple-choice question to the database and updates question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up the exam by inserting exam details and navigating to the admin panel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course options based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to the login page.
